date.description: The holiday's start date; the API's end date is not loaded, so a holiday that lasts several days shows only its first day.

name.description: The holiday's name in the configured language, or `Unknown` when the API has no name in that language.

type.description: The holiday type from the OpenHolidays list (Public, Bank, Optional, School, BackToSchool, EndOfLessons); `Unknown` when the API returns none.

regionalScope.description: Where the holiday applies: National, Regional or Local; `Unknown` when the API returns none.

temporalScope.description: How much of the day the holiday covers: FullDay or HalfDay; `Unknown` when the API returns none.

nationwide.description: True when the holiday applies in the whole country; false when only some subdivisions observe it, and the connector does not load which ones.
